title: Exact source and GitHub submission map
summary: The full dev3 ZIP retains actual clips, generated review videos, a compiled native library and a bundled NotNotes ZIP. The earlier GitHub API fallback deliberately submitted only project-owned source files for Alchemy Autobuild; media and vendor dependencies are separately supplied.
invariants: Repository Git branch is a transport envelope; do not merge submission branches directly into main.
Keep original dev3 SHA-256 distinct from source-only GitHub tree hashes.
Do not copy proprietary/private media, compiled outputs, scratch data or dependency archives into a source or sphere branch.
The sphere is documentation: it does not replace the executable package or assertions.
procedure: Check original archive hash before reconstruction.
Consult native/service_playout.c for actual media worker behavior, rexx/ServicePlayout.cls for control semantics, and docs/DEV3_WAIT_RELEASE.md for operation.
For the source-only GitHub handoff inspect commit cbdbd5c9994ecf889952a83a15ea3a0060ca967a on the immutable autobuild-submit branch.
When the actual accepted main tree differs, update this sphere's provenance, not its older history.
